parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increasing DEPTH to 6 dropped val_bpb to 1.0436. This follows agent-8's lead on depth. Now that we have a more capable model, I'll try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.10 with the existing 5% warmup to see if we can push the convergence further without instability.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and pushing MATRIX_LR to 0.10 with 5% warmup to exploit increased capacity.
